svg.title: Conservation Officer Service — cap or sweater breast crest
svg.desc: Reconstruction with supplied native vector insignia. User-supplied native insignia paths and colours are retained. Shoulders use the crown/wreath/shield/dogwood portion with the lower ribbon and side folds excluded by a fixed vector window; cap/breast uses the complete native ribbon edition. The existing scalloped cloth cut remains; the supplied lower ribbon carries the service caption without a duplicate generated text line. Exact embroidery edges, thread colours, original typeface and the uploaded artwork’s manufacturing provenance are not authenticated.
